transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess work has just been difficult lately. I do hair, and... I don't know, my hands just feel like they’re moving through glue. Like, even just sectioning hair or mixing the color, it takes me forever now. People at the salon have started noticing I’m... just slower than I used to be. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you noticed a tremor in your hands when they’re at rest?
Um... no. I don't think so. They don't really shake.
Have your muscles been feeling stiff?
Um... no. Not really. They don't feel stiff, just... heavy, I guess.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day?

Um... yeah. I guess so. Most days I just... I wake up with this heavy, flat sadness in my chest. It just feels like... I don't know. Like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning anymore. So... yeah.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually high, energized, or irritable for several days?
No... not really. I don't think I've ever felt like that.
Have you had depression like this before?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so.
Have you been speaking much less than usual?

Um... yeah. I guess I have. I just... I used to chat a lot more. Like with my clients at the salon, or... helping the newer stylists. I used to go hiking with my friends, too. But now... I don't know. I mostly just keep my head down. I try to avoid people. I just... I don't really have that spark in me right now.
Have you found yourself holding the same body position for a long time without meaning to?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. I don't think I do that.
Have you been waking up much earlier than usual and unable to get back to sleep?
No... I haven't noticed that. I usually just sleep until my alarm goes off.
Have other people noticed you staying frozen in one position for a long time?
No... nobody's mentioned anything like that to me.
Have you been moving more slowly than usual in general?
Yeah... I guess so. It just... at work, it feels like my hands are moving through glue. Like even just sectioning hair or mixing color takes me forever now. People have started noticing I'm slower...
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah... I guess so. I don't really do much lately. I used to like chatting with my clients... and helping the newer stylists out. Or going hiking with friends. But... I don't know. I mostly just keep my head down now and avoid people. I just don't have that spark in me anymore.
Have people told you that your face looks less expressive than usual?
I don't really know. Like I was just saying... I mostly just avoid people now. I don't really talk to my clients or the other stylists enough anymore for them to say anything about my face.
When you’re not feeling especially sad, do your movements still feel slowed down?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess I haven't paid that much attention to it when I'm not feeling down. It's just... hard to separate it all out.
When you walk, has anyone noticed that one of your arms swings less than the other?
No... I don't think so. No one has ever said anything like that to me.
Have you noticed that your handwriting has become smaller than it used to be?
Um, no... I haven't noticed anything like that. I don't really write much by hand anyway, so... no.
Have you noticed that your appetite has been lower than usual?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I just... I don't really think about eating lately. I've been skipping meals without really meaning to. Sometimes it gets to nighttime and I realize I only had coffee... and maybe a few bites of something. And, um... my clothes have gotten a little looser. So... yeah.
Are your movements slowest in the morning?
No... I don't really know what you mean. I just... I feel about the same most of the time.
Have you ever had encephalitis?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really know what that is, but... no.
Have you noticed that your sense of smell is weaker than it used to be?
Um... no, not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. It seems fine.
